research_question: Using the frozen EMA-aware Technical feature specification identified in RQ2, how do regularised Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost and a compact LSTM compare in retrospective walk-forward prediction of Tesla's rolling five-session mean-price trend, and does any nonlinear or sequential model provide robust incremental predictive value over linear and transparent trend baselines?

target.name: Rolling five-trading-day mean-price trend
target.interpretation_boundary: classification target, not trading win rate or an executable five-session endpoint return

input_representation.common_information_rule: All four main models receive the same six feature streams over t-19 through t.
input_representation.tabular_representation: Flatten the common 20 by 6 tensor in chronological time-major order to 120 ordered lag inputs.
input_representation.preprocessing: Fit a six-channel median imputer and StandardScaler only on unique raw feature dates available to the relevant training origins; transform the common tensor before flattening or LSTM input.
input_representation.current_day_bridge_control: The frozen RQ2 Logistic Regression using only the six values at t is recomputed as a supplementary bridge and is excluded from RQ3 model selection.

fixed.layers: one unidirectional LSTM followed by one sigmoid output

tuning.inner_rule: Choose the candidate with the highest mean inner-fold Balanced Accuracy; ties are resolved by candidate order.
tuning.lstm_epoch_rule: Use early stopping only inside inner validation folds; refit each outer or full-development model for the median selected best epoch without using the outer test or retrospective audit.
tuning.final_configuration_rule: Retune each model with three purged inner folds on the complete development period before the retrospective audit.

stochastic_ensemble.rule: Arithmetic mean of the three seed probabilities before applying threshold 0.50.
stochastic_ensemble.inner_tuning_rule: Use seed 42 during bounded inner tuning; use all three seeds only for outer-fold and full-development final fits.

transparent_baselines.Training-majority: Most common class in the applicable training period.

model_selection.rule: One-standard-error rule applied to mean outer-fold Balanced Accuracy.
model_selection.standard_error: Standard deviation of the best model's five outer-fold Balanced Accuracy values divided by sqrt(5).

primary_comparisons: Random Forest minus Lagged Logistic Regression
Compact LSTM minus Lagged Logistic Regression
uncertainty.primary_multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the three complex-versus-linear contrasts, separately by period and metric.
uncertainty.secondary_comparisons: Each main model versus Weekly-trend persistence and EMA8/13 state, Holm-adjusted separately by period and metric.

overlap_robustness.method: Evaluate the already frozen daily OOF and retrospective-audit predictions separately within five Eligible_Row_ID modulo-5 phases.
overlap_robustness.anchor: Eligible_Row_ID 0 is the first target-eligible origin on or after 2016-10-03.
overlap_robustness.purpose: Inspect whether model rankings and paired differences persist when evaluated on non-overlapping five-session forward windows.
overlap_robustness.caveat: Models are trained on the full daily development origins, and successive phase labels still share the trailing comparison window; phase results are robustness diagnostics rather than independent trials.

contents: selected model family and final development-only hyperparameters
input, upstream RQ2 protocol, RQ3 protocol and frozen-file hashes
freeze_for_rq4.prohibition: RQ4 must not change the selected model or threshold after inspecting economic returns.

scope_boundaries.assets: TSLA only; AAPL and NVDA portability checks are excluded from core RQ3.
scope_boundaries.rq2: Feature-family and moving-average-expression selection remain frozen upstream.
scope_boundaries.rq3: Classification comparison and development-only model selection.
scope_boundaries.rq4: Economic execution, holding, overlap and transaction-cost rules are out of scope.

claim_boundary: All data through July 2026 were previously inspected. The audit is a retrospective temporal audit, not a prospectively untouched confirmation.
